market_pulse.note: About $64,100, down 1.1% since midnight UTC, per CoinDesk early Wednesday; CoinGecko data at 4:00 UTC showed $64,375, down 0.9% over 24 hours. It remains roughly 26% below October's $87,200 high (CoinDesk; CoinGabbar/CoinGecko).
About $1,796, down 1.43% on CoinDesk's ticker; CoinGecko data at 4:00 UTC showed $1,801, down 1.5% over 24 hours (CoinDesk; CoinGabbar/CoinGecko).
About $2.27 trillion, down 0.1% over 24 hours, with 24-hour volume near $79.2 billion, per CoinGecko data at 4:00 UTC (CoinGabbar/CoinGecko).
About 57% per CoinGecko data; CoinCodex, which tracks a different set of coins, showed 59.58% at 6:00 UTC (CoinGabbar/CoinGecko; CoinCodex).

themes.title: Bitcoin lags stocks after Nvidia
themes.summary: Bitcoin slipped about 1% early Wednesday even as stock futures rose on Nvidia's results, holding inside the $64,000-$66,000 range it has traded in since Nov. 15 (CoinDesk; Cointelegraph).

themes.title: Basis trade yields shrink
themes.summary: Talos said the bitcoin basis trade now yields about 3% to 5% a year, near or below Treasury yields, with money reportedly shifting to stock perpetual futures (CoinDesk).

themes.title: Large bids near $60,000
themes.summary: Glassnode said the band near $60,000 is the largest single bid level on Binance since August, and resting bids within 5% of price outweigh asks about 2.3 to 1 (Cointelegraph).

themes.title: Rate-hike odds stay high
themes.summary: CME FedWatch put the odds of a December Fed rate increase at 96% ahead of Wednesday's meeting minutes (CoinDesk).

themes.title: Sentiment in extreme fear
themes.summary: Alternative.me's Fear and Greed Index read 11, down from 12 a day earlier and 59 a month ago; CoinMarketCap's version read 13 (CoinGabbar; CoinDesk).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Both down about 1% to 1.5%, with Bitcoin near $64,100 and Ether near $1,800 (CoinDesk; CoinGabbar/CoinGecko).

categories.name: Altcoins
categories.note: Mixed: Solana rose 0.91% to $74.33 and XRP held near $1, while HYPE fell 1.45% to $68.50; CoinMarketCap's Altcoin Season index rose to 54 from 48 (CoinDesk).

categories.name: Derivatives
categories.note: Futures volume rose 14.5% to $205.3 billion while open interest rose only 0.8% to $111.7 billion; liquidations climbed 34.1% to $377.4 million (CoinDesk).

categories.name: Options
categories.note: Bitcoin one-week implied volatility is about 41%, and the most-traded contracts are mostly puts, led by the $60,000 put expiring Dec. 4 (CoinDesk).

watch_list.why: Minutes from the Fed's October meeting are due Wednesday afternoon, with a December rate increase priced at about 96% (CoinDesk).
Glassnode flagged $60,000 as the lower bound where further declines could force long liquidations; $62,000 was Sunday's 18-week low (Cointelegraph).
An unlock of 3.69% of ZRO's circulating supply, about $36.55 million, is due in two days (CoinDesk).
